adjudication.accepted_scope: exact realized monthly Institutional Loan interest rebate credited on an independently required existing eligible loan only when KYB VIP eligibility and the applicable performance target were independently satisfied without creating or enlarging trading volume open interest net asset value borrowing leverage or collateral exposure

economic_contract.credit_ceiling: the lesser of exact eligible monthly interest charged and exact realized rebate credited after every account-specific program limit
economic_contract.incremental_net_saving_identity: exact realized eligible interest rebate credit minus every incremental target attainment account operating tax and opportunity cost
economic_contract.reason_public_floor_is_zero: The issuer release says borrowers may qualify but publishes no performance thresholds, enrollment state, account eligibility decision, calculation period, distribution date, termination date, or realized credit.

issuer_terms.access: all KYB-verified VIP clients; the availability paragraph specifies VIP 1 and above
issuer_terms.liquidation_warning: all Institutional Lending Account balance may be liquidated if prices move against the borrower
issuer_terms.program: Binance Institutional Loan Interest Rebate Program
issuer_terms.rebate_description: borrowers may qualify for full monthly interest rebates

prohibited_actions: borrowing increasing leverage or retaining a loan to chase the rebate
manufacturing enlarging churning self-matching or wash trading volume or Open Interest
moving or retaining assets solely to satisfy a Net Asset Value target
assuming eligibility a performance threshold full rebate enrollment duration or payment from the public release
contacting an account manager applying enrolling or disclosing records without separate explicit authority
querying signed account endpoints without both designated credentials and explicit signed GET-only authority
counting a pending displayed or estimated balance as realized cash
using the rebate to rescue an independently unprofitable loan trade or collateral strategy
double counting the credit against referral rebates fee promotions yield or another interest subsidy

signed_read_only_contract.required_reconciliation: match exact loan asset principal and month to charged interest and a successful realized rebate record; deduct every incremental target and operating cost

unresolved_gates: current account KYB VIP and regional eligibility
active program enrollment and exact applicable performance target threshold
proof that the target was satisfied independently of the rebate
existing independently required eligible loan asset principal and interest period
exact charged monthly interest and successful rebate balance record
rebate calculation cap distribution timing expiration clawback and tax treatment
every incremental account operating compliance and opportunity cost
liquidation and collateral risk of the underlying loan remains separate and cannot be netted away
retry_policy: advance only when both SIMPLE_AI_TRADING_BINANCE_MAINNET_API_KEY and SIMPLE_AI_TRADING_BINANCE_MAINNET_API_SECRET are available with explicit signed GET-only authority and an independently existing legitimate Institutional Loan question; any application enrollment borrowing repayment transfer collateral order trade or account-manager contact requires separate explicit authority
